hooks.name: Lint and test after each spec task
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, run ruff and pytest (Python, no GPU needed). Skips cleanly until Task 2 creates pyproject.toml.

action.command: sh -c 'root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd); [ -d "$root/Molt/.git" ] && root="$root/Molt"; cd "$root" || exit 1; if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run pytest -q; else echo "molt checks: no pyproject.toml yet (before Task 2), skipping"; fi'
